title: The calendar and each Plan open the Space team room in one tap

source.ref: Plans and calendar clarity audit 2026-11-25 (project thread: Audit the project and calendar system; doc https://claude.ai/artifact/GUTHmChGkqaEmPSRUdzJHz)

detail:
FOUND 2026-11-25: every Space has a team room (LIVE-2529, lib/spaces/team-room.ts) but nothing on the calendar, a Plan or the Space console links to it; the only way in is /messages. Fix: a Team room button in the calendar header and a 'Talk in team room' link on the Plan's Talk tab.

DONE 2026-11-25: the calendar header carries a Team room button (IconLink, message icon) beside Calendar settings, linking /messages/r/<room id>. The room is read on the session (lib/spaces/team-room-link.ts) so only people in it see the door. The Plan pop-up's Talk tab link comes with SCAN-1342.

verify.note: Fails today; passes once the consequence in the title holds.
